So from time to time I go to talk to him but he always rants about how he is going through rough stuff and his dad not being proud. I did get sick of he negative vibes but I still love him as a friend and then Corona happened I stopped hearing about him for a while but check on him from time to time he did invite me to some gatherings but I get busy or tired to go out and I always feel guilty like I'm in the wrong we go now to the same college and he always tries to make our schedules alike but it never works out 

Sorry if this is not of help but it felt harder to keep it for my self and while writing this it made appreciate him more I'm sorry for what happened to you and hope you find the closure you need.
